latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of youtube-analytics skill.

- Integrates YouTube Analytics API with managed OAuth via Maton.
- Retrieve channel analytics reports and performance metrics (views, watch time, subscribers, revenue).
- Includes support for report queries with filters, dimensions, and sorting.
- Manage YouTube Analytics OAuth connections (list, create, delete, specify with header).
- Allows management of video, playlist, and channel groups with explicit permission.
- Requires a Maton API key for authorization.
